method: All 14 Week 8 games are included and use the user-verified Bovada market board. For the 12 games in the immutable Nov. 1 public snapshot, original Baseline and Injury projections are preserved. Panthers-Packers uses chronological reconstruction for all four variants. Bears-Seahawks uses its saved pregame four-model research forecast. Efficiency and Combined projections are chronological weekly-fold forecasts with training strictly before Week 8.
cautions: The comparison presents all 14 games uniformly; research reconstructions are not retroactive public projections.
The Efficiency and Combined columns are reconstructed research forecasts, not original Nov. 1 public posts.
The original Baseline and Injury values are preserved from the immutable snapshot.
Missing original snapshot projections are reconstructed chronologically or use the saved pregame research forecast; they are not represented as original public posts.
No official prospective record or production model is changed.
